title: Daande Hakkille
intro: Daande newaare hakkille meeɗii renndude wasiyaaji ɓurɗi jamaanu. Ndeeɗoo limoore, barkinnde faamde luggiɗnde, rokkii janngirɗe ɗe ngalaa nafoore, heddiiɗe e lampa wonande kala yiɗɓe ardaade. Mbele aɗa waawi udditaade sifaa gonɗo caggal ɗeen kelme duumiiɗe ?
clues: Mi rokkaama neema luggiɗnde ummoraade e Alla, dokkal ngal jalbini ɓernde am e hakkille am.
Mi ƴeewi ɓiɗɗo am giɗo, miɗo yiɗi renndude e makko ngalu ɓurngu nafoore ngu njogiimi.
Mi jeertinii wonde tooñannge ɓurnde teeŋtude ko waɗde sehilaaɓe e Alla gooto goonga oo.
Mi siftinii wonde hay teddeendi ɓiɗɓe leɗɗe, suuɗnde e nder haayre walla caggal asamaan, maa Alla hiisa ɗum.
Mi yamirii yo mi waɗtu hakkille e jibnaaɓe, hay so tawii ɗooftaare ko e geɗe peewal tan.
Mi jannginii jikkuuji koyɗi: yahdu e neɗɗaagal e dow leydi, njuumtu daande maa; sabu daande ɓurnde tiiɗde ko ɓuuɓri pucci.

trial.label: Ñaawoore / Kewu
options: Mahde laana ngam daɗde e ilam mawɗam

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Wasiyaaji makko ko maayɗi e nder binndol Alla
O hokkaama annabaaku e sariya keso
O wonti laamɗo baawɗo dow laamu mawngu
O wuurtaama dow asamaan o maayaani
O heɓi wahyu laaɓtuɗo e juuɗe maleyka
outcome.answer: Wasiyaaji makko ko maayɗi e nder binndol Alla

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
